entries.title: Governance Commons Ecosystem Charter
entries.description: Founding charter of the Governance Commons ecosystem. Declares purpose, scope, authority model, and the relationship between GC standards and adopting namespaces.

entries.title: Agent Project Orchestrator — Cluster Header
entries.description: Founding record of the APO cluster. Governs the Agent Project Orchestrator protocol: how agents coordinate multi-project work, handoff governance, and orchestration contracts.

entries.title: Agent Team Protocol — Cluster Header
entries.description: Founding record of the ATP cluster. Governs multi-agent team coordination: role assignment, communication protocols, and team-level governance contracts.

entries.title: Canonical PASS Identifier Standard — Cluster Header
entries.description: Founding record of the CANON cluster. Declares the canonical PASS identifier system: format, alias model, immutability, layer grammar, registry model, external adopter model, and bootstrap acknowledgment. Establishes 8 cluster invariants.

entries.title: PASS Identifier Governance — Normative Specification
entries.description: Normative PASS identifier governance specification. Declares canonical ID grammar (ABNF), ONS conformance, namespace declaration spec (namespace.yaml), layers declaration spec, alias model, allocation authority model, sub-pass relationship model, and immutability specification. 37 normative rules.

entries.title: Registry Governance — Normative Specification
entries.description: Normative registry governance specification. Declares registry file format, entry schema (14 required fields), status taxonomy, write authority enforcement, schema validation contract, append-only changelog, CI integration contract, and dependency validation. 44 normative rules. Companion JSON Schema published at schemas/canon-registry-entry.schema.json.

entries.title: Migration Protocol — eco and GC First-Adopter
entries.description: Migration protocol for the ECO: and GC: namespaces as CANON first-adopters. Formally reverses the unauthorized named-cluster-only rule. Declares ECO: and GC: namespaces and layer bands. Declares assignment algorithm, legacy ID mapping, and conflict resolution rules. Assigns canonical IDs to CANON, ONS, ACES, OG, RT, EV, OPS, REM, APO, ATP clusters. Resolves CANON bootstrap condition.

entries.title: Ontic Namespace Structure — Canonical Naming Grammar
entries.description: Founding record of the ONS cluster. Declares the Ontic Namespace Structure canonical naming grammar for eco and GC-conformant systems. Governs identifier formation, qualification authority, and naming conformance.

entries.title: ONS Lint Rule Catalog and Naming Enforcement
entries.description: Declares the ONS lint rule catalog: machine-checkable naming rules derived from the ONS grammar. Governs CI enforcement of naming conformance.

entries.title: ONS Python AST Naming Enforcement
entries.description: Declares ONS enforcement for Python codebases via AST analysis. Governs how Python identifier conformance is checked against the ONS grammar.

entries.title: Planning Document Standard — Cluster Header
entries.description: Founding record of the DEV-ACCORD cluster. Declares the canonical planning doc types (DEV-PATH, DEV-PLAN, DEV-RELEASE, DEV-TRACKS), H1 naming rule with em dash separator, canonical doc rule, append-only constraint for DEV-PATH, and validation contract enforced by validate-planning.ps1.

entries.title: Planning Document Standard — ONS Registration
entries.description: Registers the four canonical planning doc types (DEV-PATH, DEV-PLAN, DEV-RELEASE, DEV-TRACKS) in the ONS namespace. Adds portfolio_doc_name casing domain and portfolio namespace domain to ons.yaml; creates ons/registry/doc-types.yaml.

entries.title: Execution Model — PASS, RUN, and Evidence Bundle
entries.description: Defines the three-layer execution model: PASS (governance contract), RUN (execution event), Evidence Bundle (audit record). Governing doctrine for all agents operating under GC governance.

entries.title: Agent Onboarding Protocol
entries.description: Canonical agent-agnostic onboarding protocol for all agents operating in this portfolio. Defines reading order, portfolio rules, ecosystem overview, and planning doc roles. Agent-specific bootstrap files (CLAUDE.md, CODEX.md, COPILOT.md) are thin wrappers that point here.

entries.title: Agent Bootstrap Standard
entries.description: Defines AGENTS.md as the canonical GC cross-agent bootstrap file. Separates normative GC requirements from platform auto-discovery behavior, permits runtime adapter files such as CLAUDE.md, and prohibits universal auto-read overclaims.

entries.title: DEV-DOCS Suite and GC-AUDIT Declaration
entries.description: Names DEV-DOCS as the canonical planning doc suite and declares GC-AUDIT as the portfolio-wide validation, normalization, stale-reference detection, adversarial review, trace, and close-the-loop toolchain.

entries.title: Change Playbook
entries.description: Defines BUNT, RUN, DRIVE, and PASS execution levels; per-level DEV-DOCS, validation, evidence obligations; escalation rules; and the unified commit trailer schema.

entries.title: Planning Container Lock
entries.description: Clarifies that Phase, Wave, and Track are the only GC structural planning containers and that PASS is a governance contract, not a structural planning container.

entries.title: DEV-DOCS Privacy Default
entries.description: Establishes that DEV-DOCS are private by default, defines required public-distribution .gitignore exclusions, and permits public-safe bootstrap stubs.

entries.title: Script and Tooling Placement Rule
entries.description: Declares the placement decision gate for scripts, tools, automation, and validators, keeping portfolio-level tooling in the DCP and portable standards tooling in Governance Commons.

entries.title: Git Split Authorization Rule
entries.description: Requires explicit human authorization before agents create branches, PR chains, worktrees, forks, or equivalent git topology splits; declares current-branch publish as the default.

entries.title: GC-AUDIT Diagnostic Accuracy
entries.description: Corrects recent-work and release-readiness diagnostics so authoritative PASS metadata, active release gates, repository/archive boundaries, actionable markers, and validator fixtures produce trustworthy portfolio signals.

entries.title: Authoritative PASS Status Parsing
entries.description: Reads a PASS file's line-anchored status metadata instead of matching unrelated status examples in body prose.

entries.title: Active Release Gate Semantics
entries.description: Finds the active release through either release tables or version-section status metadata, scopes nested admission criteria to that release, and fails release readiness when active gates remain unchecked.

entries.title: Repository Archive and Scratch Boundaries
entries.description: Applies one exclusion policy across recent-work scans for archives, dependency/build outputs, virtual environments, standard caches, and custom pytest/test scratch trees.

entries.title: Marker and Script Signal Quality
entries.description: Separates actionable uppercase debt markers from release checklists and quoted prose, and preserves array shape when format validation finds exactly one script.

entries.title: Brownfield Diagnostic Regression Fixtures
entries.description: Adds black-box Pester fixtures covering PASS metadata, table and section release conventions, failing release exits, archive/scratch boundaries, malformed PLAY input, and single-file format validation.

entries.title: Governance Commons Public Site Launch
entries.description: Publishes the Governance Commons ecosystem site with release-pinned standard pages, validator and schema links, conformance guidance, and a verified custom-domain deployment.

entries.title: PLAY Commit Reference Correction
entries.description: Replaces the prior PASS-5 walkthrough PLAY record's pending commit reference with the actual closing commit.

entries.title: Ecosystem Site and Per-Standard Pages
entries.description: Builds and deploys the Governance Commons landing page, four per-standard pages, validator and schema resources, and conformance badge instructions at governancecommons.org.

entries.title: OBDD Conformance and Assurance Annex
entries.description: Defines accepted OBDD v1.1 requirements for applicability, traceability, risk, agent security, evidence integrity, human oversight, assurance labels, exceptions, and maintenance without claiming certification.

entries.title: OBDD Assurance Record Contract
entries.description: Provides a machine-readable assurance record and adopter template covering external requirements, risk, evidence, controls, approvals, claims, exceptions, metrics, and source maintenance.

entries.title: OBDD Fail-Closed Assurance Validation
entries.description: Validates assurance-record structure, references, evidence maturity, authorization, safe acceptance, human accountability, regulatory context, and assurance-level boundaries.

entries.title: OBDD Assurance Regression and CI Gates
entries.description: Tests positive and negative assurance cases and runs the OBDD assurance suite on main pushes and pull requests.

entries.title: Outcome-Bound Development Directive
entries.description: Defines OBDD v1.1 objective, scope-preservation, additional-work classification, delivery-evidence, security, completion, stop-rule, and adoption-boundary requirements.
